offensive.name: Fracture Curse
offensive.description: Your spells fracture the very bones of your foes — degrading strength, compounding wounds, and eventually shattering named bones permanently.

tiers.text: On a failed save, the creature suffers a bone fracture — their Strength or Dexterity checks are reduced by 1d4 for 1 minute.
tiers.card: Fail: a fracture — −1d4 on Str or Dex checks for 1 min

tiers.text: If the target already has a Wound, the fracture deals +2d6 additional damage and reduces their movement speed by 10 feet.
tiers.card: Already Wounded: +2d6 damage and −10 ft speed

tiers.text: When you cause a creature to gain 2 or more Wounds from the same effect, it also suffers an Injury — a broken limb, shattered ribs, or similar structural failure.
tiers.card: 2+ Wounds from one effect: they also take an Injury

tiers.text: Once per long rest, name a specific bone (skull, spine, femur, etc.). If the target fails their save, that bone shatters — rendering the affected body part inoperable unless healed by Regenerate or high-level vitaemancy.
tiers.card: 1/long rest name a bone — fail and it shatters, that part inoperable until Regenerate

supportive.name: Marrowforge
supportive.description: You reinforce yourself with calcified will — building layers of bone over flesh until strikes shatter against you and enemies bleed for daring to try.

tiers.text: Gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus and +1 to AC for 1 round.
tiers.card: {PB} temp HP and +1 AC for 1 round

tiers.text: While active, gain resistance to bludgeoning damage, and your melee attacks deal +1d4 piercing or necrotic damage (your choice) as bone fragments extend from your strikes.
tiers.card: Resist bludgeoning · melee attacks +1d4 piercing or necrotic from bone spurs

tiers.text: If you have at least 1 Wound, you gain immunity to critical hits and your Wound threshold increases by +1.
tiers.card: With 1+ Wound: immune to crits and your Wound threshold rises by 1

tiers.text: Enter Bone Bastion for 1 minute — you gain immunity to nonmagical weapons, enemies that strike you with melee weapons must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 2d8 slashing damage as bone shards erupt outward, and you may reattach or regenerate broken limbs as a bonus action.
tiers.card: Bone Bastion 1 min — immune to nonmagical weapons, melee attackers Dex save or 2d8 slashing

supportive.name: Ossuary Invocation
supportive.description: You summon the memory of the dead through bone — speaking to what remains, raising skeletal champions, and eventually erupting a cathedral of the dead from the earth itself.

tiers.text: You may touch a bone and cast Speak with Dead without components — the memory held in the bone answers.
tiers.card: Touch a bone and Speak with Dead, no components

tiers.text: Revive a skeleton with limited autonomy for 10 minutes — useful for scouting, triggering traps, or operating mechanisms.
tiers.card: Raise a skeleton with limited autonomy 10 min — scouting, traps, mechanisms

tiers.text: Call forth an ancestral skeleton of a slain warrior or beast — it appears for 1 minute as a CR 10 undead construct under your complete control.
tiers.card: Call an ancestral skeleton — CR 10 undead under full control, 1 min

tiers.text: Once per long rest, invoke a Bone Cathedral — within a 30-foot radius, bones erupt from the earth, all necrotic spells are empowered (+1 die), you may resurrect up to three skeletal champions (CR 10 each), and the cathedral persists for 1 hour, granting resistance to radiant damage and immunity to Turn Undead for all creatures you summon within it.
tiers.card: 1/long rest Bone Cathedral 30 ft — necrotic effects +1 die, raise three CR 10 champions

control.name: Ossify
control.description: You transform soft tissue into unyielding bone — immobilizing limbs, seizing joints, and eventually calcifying vital organs from the inside out.

tiers.text: One limb of your choice is partially ossified — the target has disadvantage on Dexterity checks involving that limb until the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: One limb ossifies — disadvantage on Dex checks using it until your next turn

penalty.disadvantage: Dexterity checks involving that limb until the end

tiers.text: On a failed save, the limb becomes immobile for 1 round — natural or unarmed attacks made with it fail automatically.
tiers.card: Fail: that limb is dead weight 1 round, attacks with it auto-fail

tiers.text: You may now target two limbs or a jointed structure. Movement is reduced by 15 feet, and the creature suffers 1 Wound if they attempt to move with ossified parts.
tiers.card: Two limbs or a joint · −15 ft speed · 1 Wound if they move anyway

tiers.text: You may ossify vital organs (heart, lungs, throat). On a failed save the creature gains 1 Injury, loses the ability to speak, breathe, or cast spells with verbal components for 1 minute, and takes 4d12 necrotic damage as their internals calcify.
tiers.card: Ossify organs — fail: 1 Injury, no speech, breath or verbal casting 1 min, 4d12 necrotic

control.name: Bone Puppeteer
control.description: You control skeletal structures with a snap of your will — animating the dead, restraining the living through their own bones, and puppeting the fallen as extensions of your intent.

tiers.text: Animate one nearby skeleton or bone pile as a minion for 1 minute. It follows simple mental commands (AC 13, HP 15, deals 1d6 damage).
tiers.card: Animate a skeleton or bone pile 1 min (AC 13, 15 HP, 1d6)

tiers.text: You may control existing skeletons or target a living creature with visible bones. On a failed save they are Restrained as their own skeleton briefly resists them.
tiers.card: Control existing skeletons · living targets fail = Restrained by their own bones

tiers.text: Use bone control to force a creature to move up to 15 feet against their will (as if grappled) or make a single melee attack against another creature of your choice.
tiers.card: Force a creature to move 15 ft, or make one melee attack on a target you pick

tiers.text: Dominate up to three bone-possessing creatures simultaneously. Once per long rest, you may fully puppet an unconscious or paralyzed creature as if using Dominate Monster, bypassing immunities.
tiers.card: Dominate three bone-bearing creatures · 1/long rest fully puppet an unconscious one, ignoring immunities

creation.name: Ossuary Craft
creation.description: Structure is what remains — so build with what remains.

tiers.text: Your creations are bone. A Structure shaped as a cage Restrains a creature inside it until it escapes with a Strength check against your Verum DC. Constructs are undead — immune to poison damage and exhaustion. Objects deal +1d4 necrotic damage on a hit.
tiers.card: Creations are bone · cage Structures Restrain (Str check {DC}) · Constructs undead · Objects +1d4 necrotic

tiers.text: Your creations are immune to necrotic and poison damage. Structures grow spurs — a creature that touches or strikes one takes 1d8 piercing damage. A Construct raised from a corpse or bone pile keeps that creature's size and Strength score.
tiers.card: Immune to necrotic and poison · Structures grow spurs, 1d8 piercing to touch · Constructs keep the corpse's size and Str

tiers.text: Constructs are immune to Turn Undead. Once per seal, you may raise a Structure as a bonus action if you stand on ground that holds the dead — a battlefield, a crypt, a grave. An Object may be a memory-bone that answers one question as Speak with Dead.
tiers.card: Constructs immune to Turn Undead · 1/seal raise a Structure as a bonus action on ground holding the dead

tiers.text: A Structure made with a 7th-level slot or higher is a consecrated ossuary: undead you control within 30 feet gain resistance to radiant damage. Once per seal, a destroyed Construct reassembles at 1 hit point at the start of your next turn.
tiers.card: 7th+ Structure is a consecrated ossuary — your undead within 30 ft resist radiant · 1/seal a destroyed Construct reassembles at 1 HP

utility.name: Reliquary Sense
utility.description: Bones keep the record long after the ink has faded.

tiers.text: Sense skeletons, living or dead, within 60 feet. Learn a bone's owner, age, and cause of death by touch. Set and splint a fracture, removing its penalty.
tiers.card: Sense skeletons 60 ft · read a bone's owner, age and cause of death · set a fracture

tiers.text: Lighten your skeleton for 1 hour — jump three times as far and halve falling damage. Find a specific person's remains within 1 mile if you hold something that was theirs.
tiers.card: Lighten your skeleton 1 hr — jump triple, half falling damage · find remains within 1 mile from a keepsake

tiers.text: You and up to three companions gain a climb speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour as bone hooks grow from your hands. Reconstruct a creature's full form as an image from a single fragment.
tiers.card: You and 3 others get a climb speed for 1 hr · rebuild a creature's image from one fragment

tiers.text: The Long Record — touch a bone at least a century old and witness one scene from its owner's life. Or knit a shattered skeleton whole, curing structural Injuries and restoring the bone of a lost limb for Regenerate to finish.
tiers.card: The Long Record — a century-old bone shows a scene from its owner's life · or knit a skeleton whole, curing Injuries

complementEffects.name: Splinter
complementEffects.description: The impact doesn't just wound — it fragments, sending bone shards tearing outward into every creature nearby.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, bone shards erupt from the point of impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the target (including the target) must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or take 1d8 piercing damage.
effect.card: Shards erupt — everyone within 5 ft (target included) Dex save {DC} or 1d8 piercing

upgrades.text: The damage increases to 2d8, the radius increases to 10 feet, and creatures that fail have their movement speed reduced by 5 feet until they receive any healing.
upgrades.card: 2d8 · radius 10 ft · those who fail lose 5 ft speed until healed

upgrades.text: The damage increases to 3d8, and creatures that fail the Dexterity save also have disadvantage on their next attack roll as embedded shards catch on muscle and joint.
upgrades.card: 3d8 · those who fail also have disadvantage on their next attack

penalty.disadvantage: their next attack roll as embedded shards catch on

complementEffects.name: Calcify
complementEffects.description: Structure hardens where structure is needed most — a thin layer of calcified bone forming over skin to absorb what follows.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, you or one ally within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your spellcasting modifier as a thin layer of calcified bone briefly forms over exposed skin.
effect.card: You or an ally within 30 ft: {PB}+{VM} temp HP from a bone layer

upgrades.text: The temporary HP increases to twice your proficiency bonus + your spellcasting modifier, and the ally also gains +1 to AC until the temporary HP is depleted.
upgrades.card: Temp HP doubles · +1 AC while any remains

upgrades.text: You may choose two creatures to receive this benefit, and while the temporary HP remains, each is immune to being knocked prone — the bone layer keeping them grounded and stable.
upgrades.card: Two creatures · each immune to prone while the temp HP lasts

complementEffects.name: Joint Lock
complementEffects.description: The skeleton turns against its owner — joints seizing mid-motion, stripping speed and reaction before the target can understand what is happening.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Verum DC or have their movement speed reduced by 15 feet and lose their reaction until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Con save {DC} or −15 ft speed and lose reactions until end of their next turn

upgrades.text: On a failed save, the target also cannot take the Dash action until the end of their next turn — their locked joints making any burst of speed impossible.
Creatures that fail are also unable to make opportunity attacks and suffer disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the end of their next turn — every joint in their body working against them.
upgrades.card: Also no opportunity attacks and disadvantage on Dex saves

penalty.disadvantage: Dexterity saving throws until the end of their nex
